business_summary: Fujipream Corporation engages in the precision laminating and high-functional composite materials business in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Precision Laminating and High-Performance Composite Materials, and Environmental Living Space and Engineering. The Precision Laminating and High-Performance Composite Materials segment produces touch panel sensor substrates and components for liquid crystal displays, as well as manufactures and sells automotive parts. The Environmental Living Space and Engineering segment includes solar cell modules, solar power generation system-related products, insulation generation systems, and film-laminated glass for general use and shatter-proofing. This segment also engages in logistics-related operations, and operates a mechanical electronics business. It also offers packing materials, such as plastic products; sheets, covers, and bags; packing boxes and molded trays; corrugated plastic sheets; moisture-proof sheets for packaging; and other products, such as curing tapes, stretch film, color stretch film, OPP tape, and PP band, as well as pallet products, and cushioning materials and processed products. In addition, the company provides functional films, including anti-scattering films, decorative films, heat shielding films, UV cut films, anti-reflection films, antibacterial and anti-viral films, etc. Fujipream Corporation was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Himeji, Japan.
